blocks.title: Class aur object
blocks.text: Class cheezein banane ka saancha hai, aur object us saanche se bani asal cheez. Har object class ka instance hai, apni qeematon ke saath.

Khilona gari banane ke liye pehle aisa naqsha chahiye jo us ka rang, size, pahiyon ki tadaad aur maadda bataye. Naqsha gari nahi; woh class hai. Us se bani gariyan, har ek apne rang ya size ke saath, woh objects hain jin se aap khel sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Class aur object mein farq samjhaiye (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Class aisa mansooba hai jo batata hai ke us ke objects ke kaunse attributes aur methods honge; object us mansoobe se bana ek asal instance hai jis ki apni qeematein hain: ToyCar class hai, car1 (laal, chhoti, 4 pahiye) object hai.

items: Class: saancha (naqsha); object: us se bana instance apni qeematon ke saath.
